summary: CoreAudioKit is the view layer for Audio Unit plugin UIs, Bluetooth and network MIDI/audio device pickers and inter-app audio widgets. BifrOSt has no Audio Unit host and no AU view API; its audio service and Bluetooth module cover playback routing and device status but none of the CoreAudioKit views. A pure network audio browser model (receiver discovery, expiry and route picker rows) is built in springboard/ui/src/network_audio_browser.rs but is not wired into the shell.

features.feature: Audio unit custom UI (view controller, view configuration, generic view)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/param_view.rs (ParamSpec, GenericView); wired: springboard/apps/daw/src/rack.rs (slider mapping over springboard/ui/src/param_view.rs); springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-18.rs
features.note: Headless tests in parity_sdk-tests-18 cover the generic parameter view: expert filtering, clamping, linear and logarithmic slider positions, invalid ranges and reset. The DAW rack maps its sliders through the model. Gap: no Audio Unit host and no plugin view controller; the DAW plugins use built-in device UIs, and the generic ViewController in springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs is not audio-specific.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 3 (w3-coreaudiokit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No panner unit or specialised panner UI.

features.feature: Bluetooth MIDI peripheral picker and advertising
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/midi_ble_picker.rs (MidiPicker, MidiAdvertiser::scan_response); springboard/ui/src/midi_ble.rs (BLE MIDI packets); tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-13.rs
features.note: The MIDI service UUID, the advertisement and scan response that complete a shortened name, the picker's list and selection, and BLE MIDI packet encoding are tested headless (parity_sdk-complete-13.rs and the picker's unit tests). Gap: the GATT connection and the peripheral role need the Bluetooth radio, so they are checked only on the lab machine, and the picker is not wired into apps or the shell.
built on parity/team-j-audio-unit; not yet verified on Midget. Pure model: the discovery source reports announcements and expiry times; no socket is opened and no receiver is contacted.

features.feature: Audio route indicator for connected devices
features.apple: Route picker shown with now playing (CoreAudioKit does not supply it; listed for context)
features.note: Shows the connected Bluetooth audio device name in Now Playing. It is not a reusable SDK route picker for apps.

features.feature: Audio playback service shared by apps
features.apple: Not part of CoreAudioKit (AVFoundation and Core Audio); listed because CoreAudioKit device views depend on it
features.note: Apps share the audio service through bifrost_app::audio::Client, used by the music, podcasts, video player and voice memos apps. Headless tests in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-12.rs drive it over a Unix socket with a fake service: handshake, state, transport and queue commands, volume clamping and reconnect. Gap: the service itself owns the speaker and plays sound only on the lab machine.
Lists iOS devices that support inter-device audio. Apple-device-only feature with no BifrOSt counterpart.

features.feature: Inter-App Audio switcher and transport views
features.note: Deprecated in iOS 13 and unavailable for iPad apps on macOS per the Apple page.
Deprecated Apple internals with no BifrOSt counterpart.

gaps: No Audio Unit host: BifrOSt cannot load third-party AU plugins or show their custom views (AUViewController, AUAudioUnitViewConfiguration).
No generic audio unit view (AUGenericView) or panner view (AUPannerView) for plugins without a custom UI.

No BLE MIDI radio path for apps: the picker and the advertiser are models (springboard/ui/src/midi_ble_picker.rs, MidiPicker and MidiAdvertiser; tests midi_ble_picker::tests), not connected to the Bluetooth controller or any app.
Bluetooth audio streaming (A2DP/AVDTP) is not handled in springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs, so a device picker would list devices that cannot carry audio yet.
No SDK route picker for apps: the picker rows exist in springboard/ui/src/route_picker.rs but no SDK API exposes them.
No discovery source for network audio receivers; the browser model is fed by the caller and nothing scans the network yet.
